name: Ebenica Coffee
notes: robots.txt User-agent: * has "Disallow: /wp-json/" - the ONLY shop that forbids the Store API. API technically returns 200 JSON but a polite adapter must fall back to HTML here. Single variation attribute "gramáž (produkt)" (taxonomy pa_variant-kosik); no origin attributes, no Label: value lines in the description either.

name: Goriffee Roastery
notes: description empty across the sample (short_description carries the copy). Coffee products do expose 6 origin attributes.

name: Diamond's Roastery
notes: 8 variations per product, 2 attributes (Hmotnosť, Mletie) plus tag-based flavour descriptors (cokoladova, ovocna, sladka) which are useful as tasting notes.

name: Illimité Coffee Roasters
notes: Behind Cloudflare but no challenge for a plain UA (200 JSON). Only one category exists: 107 zrnkova-vyberova-kava (4 products). Origin data is in the description as Label: value lines (Farma, Farmár, Nadmorská výška, Oblasť, Odroda, Príprava, Spracovanie).

name: Good Times Coffee Roasters
notes: Only one category exists (47 premium, 3 products) - no "kava" slug to filter on. Origin data is in the description as Label: value lines.

name: 25COFFEE

attributes_seen.name: Ak by ste túto kávičku radi vyskúšali, prosím Vás vyberte si hmotnosť balenia.

notes: Category slugs are grind/type based (zrnkova-kava-100-arabica, zrnkova-bezkofeinova-kava, nase-vlastne-zmesi, cascara). Origin data in description Label: value lines.

name: Caffe4U
notes: Category endpoint returns duplicate entries with 16-digit synthetic ids (e.g. 9003241321018644 prazena-kava alongside 17 prazena-zrnkova-kava, both count 45) - a plugin injects virtual terms. Prefer the small integer ids. Richest attribute set of the survey (16 attributes incl. Kyslosť kávy, Horkosť kávy, Zloženie kávy).

name: Trinity Beans
notes: 28-field (older) schema, simple products only, 11 attributes incl. Skóre kvality, Obdobie zberu, Klasifikácia kávy.

name: Kaan Roastery

sample_names: Papierové filtre pre Fellow Aiden – 50 ks

notes: Simple products with real SKUs; X-WP-Total 76 for a shop the first wave counted at 17 coffees - the API total covers the whole catalogue incl. variations/other types.

name: Zarno
notes: No coffee-named categories at all: arabica(4), robusta(3), zmes(4), nezaradena(1). Category filtering must be per-shop configured.

name: Sweet Beans Coffee Roastery

sample_names: Colombia Jorge Rojas x natural gesha

notes: English-language shop (EN label lines: Altitude, Process, Producer, Varieties, Location) though it is an SK roaster; categories in English (coffee-beans 31, specialty-beans 12).

name: Spirit Coffee
notes: Simple products only; second sampled product has a 94-char description. Label lines present (Chuť, Dozvuk, Praženie, výška).

name: Industra Coffee
notes: Bilingual (CZ/EN, WPML-style): categories are duplicated per language (espresso-2 appears twice with different ids, filtrovana-kava/filter-coffee, kava/coffee). Sampled products were soaps, so 0 attributes in this sample; description uses EN/CZ "Weight:/Hmotnost:" label lines.

name: Beansmith's Coffee Roastery (Kofárna)
notes: Bilingual CZ/EN: kava(67)/coffee(58), filtr(37)/filter(35), espresso(30)/espresso(28) are the same products in two languages - an adapter must pick one language tree or it will double-count.

name: COKAFE
notes: CZK, 7 attributes; catalogue mixes a bakery (cerstve-pecivo 10, cukrarna 6) with coffee (56 kava, 11).

name: QB Coffee Roasters

html_fallback.conclusion: Shoptet storefront, not WooCommerce - no li.product / woocommerce-loop-product__title / .woocommerce-product-attributes markup. Needs a Shoptet adapter.

notes: NOT WooCommerce. eshop.qb.coffee is a Shoptet store (168 KB of "shoptet" markup, data-micro-identifier product tiles, openresty 404 on /wp-json/*). Misclassified in the first wave; needs a Shoptet adapter, not the Woo one.
suggested_coffee_categories_note: no usable coffee category - take the whole catalogue and filter by product/type heuristics

name: Triple Five Coffee
notes: Simple products, bilingual description label lines (SK + EN). X-WP-Total 136 vs 11 coffees on the category page - filter by category 27/100 kava.

name: Káva Ondrejka

sample_names: Etiópia Gesha – Karamachi Farm- Natural Wine Process
Brazília – Triangulo Mineiro – Fazenda Pereira – Natural

notes: 5 attributes incl. Spôsob spracovania, Odroda, Nadmorská výška; only 7 products.

name: Mlsnacava
notes: robots.txt returns 404 (no robots file). Store API fine. Both description AND short_description are empty in the API (page-builder content) and the only attribute is "Veľkosť balenia" -> no origin data at all from the API; a second product is type "yith_bundle" (YITH bundles plugin).

name: ZRNCO
notes: description empty (page builder); short_description is a flavour sentence. Attributes are shop-specific upsell labels ("Čerstvo pražená výberová káva", "Praženie (od 500g)", "\"Vylepši\" si kávu sám") rather than origin data. 11 variations per product.

name: Kmen Coffee Roasters
notes: CZK with currency_minor_unit = 0 (prices are whole crowns, NOT hundredths) - the adapter must honour currency_minor_unit. One sampled product has zero images.

name: KÁVALOKA
notes: CZK with currency_minor_unit = 0. 24 variations per product; 11 attributes.

name: LONGBERRY

sample_names: Pákový kávovar ROCKET Boxer EVO 2 group

notes: One sampled simple product has price "0" (price on request / machine). Duplicated category trees again (kava 156 and kava-2 581, both count 31). Sampled products were a blend and an espresso machine -> 0 attributes in this sample.

name: Epera Coffee
notes: 12 attributes including SCA-style fields; category cerstva-kava(25) + vzorky-kavy(17).

name: Two Hands Roastery
notes: 28-field schema. Only a weight attribute, but the description carries a full Label: value block (Odroda, Spracovanie, Region, Stupeň praženia, Cupping score, Chuťový profil).

name: Severan

sample_names: GUATEMALA SHB – (Strictly Hard Bean) – najvyššia kvalita

notes: description empty; short_description contains an HTML <table class="coffee-table"> with Chuť/Praženie style rows plus icons - needs table parsing rather than Label: value. Prices use a dot decimal separator in price_html.

name: Ripit Roastery
notes: Mixed: one sampled variable product has no price_range, the other has one. 15 attributes - richest SK set.

name: Trip Coffee Roasters
notes: Variable product returned without price_range. Sampled items included merch, so some attributes are Rozmer/Potlač.

name: Fine Coffee SK
notes: Weight-only attribute, but description carries Farma/Lokalita/Nadmorská výška/Odroda/Spracovanie/Chuťový profil lines. SKUs populated.

name: Karma Coffee
notes: Real attribute gap: coffee products carry NO WooCommerce attributes, description is theme/nav markup and short_description is a <pre> narrative blob. Origin data would have to be NLP-extracted or scraped from the HTML detail page.

name: Rikša Káva
notes: Oldest Store API schema in the survey (27 fields, no slug/weight/dimensions/_links). Only one category: 16 ponuka-kav (11).

name: Bozin Roastery
notes: Largest catalogue (X-WP-Total 328). Category tree mixes coffee with machines (domaca-priprava-kavy 147, domace-kavovary 13); the real bean category is 51 kava (32).

name: Doraz Café & Roastery
notes: Older Store API build: variable products come back WITHOUT prices.price_range (only a single price). No "kava" category at all - coffee lives in arabiky(11)/blendy(3).

name: Aurelica
notes: Behind Cloudflare, no challenge. 8 attributes but they are tasting sliders (Intenzita, Kyslosť, Sladkosť, Horkosť) rather than origin fields.

name: TOKY Caffé
notes: No attributes; the facts live in the description as "Druh: .. Obal: .. Hmotnosť: .." label lines - parseable with a Label: value extractor.

name: Poetry Coffee
notes: Sampled products were brewers (Hario, French press) -> no attributes in this sample; only 11 products total of which ~4 are coffees.

name: ViEM Coffee

sample_names: Kolumbia Pink Bourbon by Hugo Gualaco

notes: 28-field schema. Long description with a rich Label: value block (Farma, Majiteľ, Nadmorská výška, Odroda, Cuppingové skóre...). Only one category: 19 kava-na-espresso.

name: Serious Coffee
notes: 2 attributes + full Label: value description block; categories are vyberova(4), decaf(1), espresso-blend(1).

name: Victory – Káva víťazov
notes: X-WP-Total says 1 while the endpoint returns 2 items - the count header is unreliable here (caching/filter plugin); paginate until an empty page instead of trusting the header. Products have 20-30 variations each.
suggested_coffee_categories_note: no usable coffee category - take the whole catalogue and filter by product/type heuristics
